The culture media used in fermentation are dairy based. Colour and flavour additions, where used, are declared on the product specification and introduce no additional allergen. Sanitation between products on the shared line follows a validated wet clean with allergen swab verification at a limit of 5 ppm total milk protein.

This declaration reflects the formulation in effect at the date of preparation shown above and is valid until 30 June 2027, or until the formulation changes, whichever occurs first. A revised declaration is issued automatically on any change of formulation, supplier or plant.
